days.subtheme: Permission to rest, without earning it first
days.title: You Don't Have to Earn Rest Tonight
days.featured_quote: You don't need a reason to rest. Being tired is reason enough.
script_lines: You do not have to earn rest.
Rest is not a reward for exhaustion.
It's allowed simply because you're tired.
Somewhere along the way, rest became something to justify.
But your body was never asking for permission.
It was asking for care.
Tonight, let rest be enough on its own.

days.subtheme: The guilt that shows up when you slow down
days.title: Why Resting Still Feels Like Failing
days.featured_quote: Guilt is not proof you're falling behind — it's proof you're still learning how to rest.
script_lines: You rest and immediately think about what you 'should' be doing.
That's not laziness. That's conditioning.
Somewhere you learned your worth is measured in output.
But you are not a machine that needs justifying.
You're allowed to stop without a reason.
Guilt isn't proof you're doing something wrong.
It's proof you're unlearning an old rule.

days.subtheme: Rest is not laziness — the reframe
days.title: Rest Isn't Laziness — Here's the Real Difference
days.featured_quote: Rest isn't giving up. It's how you stay able to keep going.
script_lines: Rest is not the opposite of productivity.
It's what makes the next step possible.
A phone dies without charging — so do you.
Laziness avoids what matters. Rest returns you to it.
You are not behind for needing to pause.
Every living thing rests. It's not a flaw, it's design.
Let today be proof rest and progress can coexist.

days.title: How to Let Today Go Without Fixing It
days.featured_quote: Some days don't need fixing. They just need to end gently.
script_lines: The day doesn't need your permission to end.
But you might need permission to let it go.
Whatever didn't get finished can wait until tomorrow.
Tonight isn't about tying up every loose end.
It's about putting the day down gently.
Not fixing it. Not reliving it. Just releasing it.
Let the evening be soft, not another task.

days.subtheme: Reflecting on the day without judgment
days.title: Stop Judging Today. Start Reflecting On It.
days.featured_quote: You can look back at today with curiosity instead of judgment.
script_lines: Looking back doesn't mean picking yourself apart.
You can review today without grading it.
Some days you show up fully. Some days you survive.
Both deserve the same gentle attention.
Ask what happened, not what's wrong with you.
Reflection is a mirror, not a courtroom.
You get to be curious instead of critical.

days.title: Saying No Tonight Is Self-Respect, Not Selfishness
days.featured_quote: Protecting your peace is not selfish. It's how you stay whole.
script_lines: Saying no to more tonight is not weakness.
It's a boundary you're finally keeping with yourself.
Overextending isn't dedication. It's a habit you can break.
Choosing rest is choosing to stay whole.
It's not selfish. It's sustainable.
You matter in the plan, not just the results.
Respect yourself enough to stop before you're empty.

days.subtheme: Carrying calm into the new week
days.title: The Exhale Before Your Next Week Starts
days.featured_quote: You don't have to earn a soft ending to a hard week.
script_lines: You made it through another week.
However it went, you're still here, still trying.
You don't need a perfect week to deserve rest.
Take one slow breath before the next one starts.
Whatever you're carrying, you can set some of it down.
Tonight is just for you, not for planning ahead.
Let this be the exhale before the next breath.
